title: Enterprise Request Portfolio Gatekeeper — Sales/CS Aggregation & First-Pass Scoping
creator: Elena García
description:
Problem: Sales and Customer Success funnel dozens of non-bug enterprise feature requests that are heterogeneous in detail, economics, and compliance needs. Without a consistent gatekeeping step, PMs spend repeated cycles re-contextualizing asks, leading to long lead times, scope creep, and missed prioritization signals.

Goal: Deliver a repeatable 'Portfolio Gatekeeper' process and artifact set for Sales/CS to use as the canonical first-pass for enterprise feature requests. The Gatekeeper should normalize signals, apply a lightweight scoring rubric (value, risk, engineering effort, ops cost, regulatory constraints), and output: 1) a one-page scoping canvas per request, 2) prioritization score, and 3) recommended next step (design spike / solution sketch / backlogged).

Deliverables: 1) Intake form template (Google Form + Drive doc) that standardizes required inputs for PM scoping; 2) Scoring rubric spreadsheet with formulae and provenance; 3) One-page scoping canvas template (Confluence + PDF) with sections: request summary, customer profile & ARR estimate, success metrics, compliance flags, proposed acceptance criteria, rough effort (T-shirt), recommended rollout path (hosted/dedicated/private), and blockers; 4) Lightweight automation script (GitHub) to convert submitted form into a pre-populated Confluence canvas and append to the intake queue; 5) Runbook for Sales/CS to operate Gatekeeper (playbook + training slides); 6) Dashboard (Looker/Grafana) that surfaces queued asks, scores distribution, and account-level concentration.

Acceptance criteria: 
- Intake template validated with Sales/CS pilot group (>= 8 reps) and updated after two pilot submissions.
- Automation populates Confluence canvas for >90% of required fields.
- Scoring rubric produces stable ordering for a pilot set of 30 historical requests (correlation with PM retrospective prioritization > 0.7).
- Gatekeeper playbook used in at least 10 new incoming requests and notes captured in the intake dashboard.
- Handoffs to Eng/Design include clear required fields so downstream triage meeting < 30 minutes per request.

Non-goals: This ticket does not implement enforcement (hard-blocking policies) or replace account-level prioritization decisions. This is for initial scoping and prioritization signal generation only.

Signals to monitor: time from intake to first-scoped canvas, percent of requests needing >1 follow-up from Sales/CS, score distribution skew, number of asks flagged for compliance review, and downstream engineering estimate variance vs initial t-shirt size.
